name: Douglas Odell
byline: Software engineer, technology strategist, and team leader
intro: Senior frontend-leaning engineer with 10+ years of experience building complex, interactive web applications in React and TypeScript. Track record of owning full-stack features end-to-end, contributing to shared component libraries, and mentoring engineering teams. Comfortable in fast-paced SaaS environments with evolving requirements. Looking to contribute to teams building intuitive, performant, and scalable collaborative experiences.

entries.title: Software Engineer
accomplishments: Built and maintained 10+ full-stack web applications for financial professionals using React, TypeScript, and JavaScript, with C#/.NET middleware and SQL, collaborating with PM, design, and backend teams to deliver features from ideation through launch.
Architected a 35+ component React UI library adopted across 10+ applications, improving consistency, accelerating development velocity, and shaping frontend standards across the org.
Designed and implemented an in-house secure site search system (React + .NET Core + Postgres + AWS), reducing reliance on third-party vendors and cutting operational costs.
Led the migration of 185 legacy web forms to React with REST API integrations, eliminating major tech debt and improving maintainability.
Delivered Jamstack migrations for 3 public websites (Gatsby + GraphQL + Contentful + Netlify), improving performance and enabling non-technical content management.
Integrated third-party systems (Google Analytics, SearchBlox, ServiceNow, Cvent) into a home‑grown ecosystem to improve analytics, search, and content workflows.
Served as repository code owner, conducting code reviews and driving engineering quality through change-management processes.

entries.title: Manager, Web Development & UX
accomplishments: Managed, mentored, hired, and technically supported a team of 5–10 engineers across varying skill levels.
Collaborated across functions as contributor, technical lead, and scrum master, bridging designers, PMs, and backend engineers.
Improved the development support queue process, reducing manual administrative overhead by 25%.

entries.title: Front End Application Developer
accomplishments: Supported and enhanced 10+ internal and external web applications, contributing to UI development, content management, and iterative improvements.
Provided indispensable customer service to internal clients through a high-volume web request queue.

entries.title: Web Designer & Developer
accomplishments: Designed and built client websites using WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace; consulted on UX, design, and implementation for small business owners.
Designed and developed custom wedding websites using NextJS, MantineUI, Hubspot integration, hosted on Cloudflare

items.name: CSS Frameworks (Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Mantine UI)
